See AMC.1191 (e)
(a) Each engine, auxiliary power unit, fuel burning heater and other combustion equipment must be isolated from the rest of the UAV by firewalls, shrouds or equivalent means.
(b) Each firewall or shroud must be constructed, so that no hazardous quantity of liquid, gas or flame can pass from that compartment to other parts of the UAV.
(c) Each opening in the firewall or shroud must be sealed with close fittings, fireproof grommets, bushings or firewall fittings offering at least as much thermal and flame protection as the firewall itself.
(d) Reserved.
(e) Each firewall, shroud and firewall fitting must be fireproof and protected against corrosion.
